answer_2.quote: We use a custom matching algorithm based on regex patterns to extract the time and date from the model responses... Our regex evaluator achieves an accuracy of at least 98% for each model on the test set portion of the annotated subset.

answer_4.quote: We ask two independent annotators to evaluate a sample of 3,600 model responses for their correctness (true / false) compared to the gold answers. Both annotators are fluent in English and are familiar with the task at hand.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label each model response as correct or incorrect by comparing it to the gold-standard answer.
